You can be spiritual and still enjoy nice things.

Kevin Trudeau explains an idea he calls spiritual materialism: a spiritual life and a material life are not opposites. In his view, you can enjoy the things you want and still live a deeply spiritual life.

The difference, Kevin says, is attachment. He shares a simple phrase for it: love people and use things, instead of loving things and using people.

Which one do you catch yourself doing more often?
